# ease-pass contact sheet — colour unverified: character grids, no colour (rule 5)
# Part 1 of 2 (ease-pass-contact-sheet-1.txt … ease-pass-contact-sheet-2.txt), each at most 180 000 B.
#
# Promise: the three mock screens (main, commit, merge) are what the app draws and how it behaves — roles you can tell apart, the commit screen telling you what goes in, a merge you resolve in five keys; each of the nine journeys is walked at or under the note's count (TESTING.md "Ease pass acceptance"). Judge each capture beside the mock named in its caption.
#
# Generated by scripts/contact-sheet.sh — do not hand-edit; edit
# ease-pass-contact-sheet-captions.tsv and re-run instead.
#
# 55 captures in all, in ticket order.
#
# These are character-grid captures (pyte/TestBackend), not pixels:
# colour is never verifiable from this file. Judge colour only in a
# real terminal, never from a capture (CLAUDE.md rule 5).
#
# Scroll once: each capture is delimited by a heading naming its
# file (docs/shots/<name>) and what right looks like for it.
